description: Agents reference a secret by its slug, never by its value.
everyoneNote: Builders can attach it to agents in this project.
jsonHint: A flat JSON object — no nesting or arrays.
nestedNotSupported: Nested objects and arrays are not supported.
onlyMeNote: You pick it when an agent asks for your own value.
slugHint: How the secret is referenced. Cannot be changed later.
